metadata.dataset: OSM road centerlines within 2 mi of the NCT centerline
metadata.source: OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik state extracts (north-dakota, minnesota, wisconsin, michigan, ohio, pennsylvania, new-york, vermont), ODbL
metadata.corridor: 2 mi buffer of site/data/centerline-*.geojson, buffered per UTM zone
metadata.note: Ways crossing a state line are split at the Geofabrik state boundary (one feature per state).
metadata.split: Chunk of osm-roads.geojson (242491 features) — centroid longitude >= -84.253 (median); split by scripts/split_oversized_layers.py because GitHub rejects files over 100 MB.
